author: Alexis Johnson
title: The Format schedules Minneapolis shows and benefit release for immigrant-rights groups - NewsBreak
text:
By Alexis Johnson ,
1 days ago The Format has scheduled two $52 ticketed concerts at Minneapolis’ First Avenue on Sept. 18 and 19, followed by a free 2 p.m. show on Sept. 19. The free performance is part of the band’s Saturdays in the Park series, although the Minneapolis event is being held at First Avenue rather than in a park, MinnPost reported. First Avenue’s Mainroom holds 1,550 people and began as a Greyhound bus depot in 1937 before becoming a music venue; it was also featured in Prince’s film Purple Rain, according to Meet Minneapolis.
